name: tracer
description: Which session did what — a structural index over Claude Code's own transcripts (~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl), verbatim, no LLM pass. Its own command, `tracer` (bin/, on the Bash PATH while the plugin is on), with two groups: `tracer sessions` (ls · live · show · replay · turns · search — the conversations) and `tracer trace` (every tool call, plus turn · blame · index — what was done in them); every older spelling still runs, unlisted. With the ak CLI installed the same groups are also `ak sessions` and `ak trace`. Also the /tracer:trace, :blame and :index skills, and a Stop-hook index writer (it also launches the tool-call indexer this plugin ships under traces/, the store behind `tracer trace`). Its index lives under ~/.claude/plugins/data/conversation-index; it needs no vault, no ak and no other plugin.

gives: ak sessions — your past sessions, searchable from the shell
ak trace blame <file> — which session touched a file
/tracer:trace in Claude Code — what a past session did, step by step
setup.changes: an index of your history under ~/.claude/plugins/data, updated after every turn
